title: Mangrove Loss Slowed, But 3.6 Million Hectares Vanished
hook: Mangrove loss slowed after millions of hectares disappeared.
closing: Slower loss matters because every surviving mangrove still shields a coastline.
question: Can protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove area lost 3.6 million hectares, shrinking a natural barrier that shields coastlines.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, the largest regional decline shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares, proving protection can reduce destruction before it stops.
